title: Carve 0.2 heading slug
description: The two character tables of the slug that gives a heading its generated id (C2-H-143 to C2-H-148): the characters removed before the slug is computed, and the glyphs written back to their ASCII source. `removed` is sorted by `code_point`, `reversed` by `glyph`.

code_point.description: The removed character, as `U+` and four to six upper-case hex digits, since most of these characters are invisible.

name.description: The Unicode name of the character, in lower case.

glyph.description: One character, typed or written by smart typography.

ascii.description: The ASCII characters that stand for the glyph in the slug.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
